title: Anyone been here? A dirty, grimey mall
content: The outside of this mall is always the same. Run down. The mall is pretty big and half the parking lot is always empty. The rest is jam packed with cars. Even if you think you know where you parked, you don't. Your car is never there when you come out of the mall. To the very far end of the mall is a large empty store. The windows are covered in dirt. The floor, walls and ceilings too. There have been times when I'm in danger and this ends up being a safe zone. Inside the first part of the mall there are several small businesses here and there. Every once in a while you might see a person. They always seem to be in their own world, not paying attention to their surroundings. There is also a hidden trap door near one of the stores that leads down to the sewers. It leads to one area, a dead end with a waterfall. Behind it is a tomb with a coffin inside. Some kind of monster, maybe a vampire, comes out of this and quickly chases you. Several times I've been caught and I'll wake up. But there have been times I make it out and get back into the mall. A little further down is an area that always stands out. It's the very center of the mall and there are all sorts of vehicles just parked here. All mixed up. There are also a lot of old winnebegos here. Everything is covered in dust. There are piles of dirt in between all the vehicles. From here you can either take the exits located to the front and back of the mall, or you can continue going on. The next area seems to be the only place that is packed with people. You can find all sorts of entertainment in this circular area. Whenever I've dreamed of this place, the entertainment area gets bigger that it almost reaches the vehicle graveyard. There is a wing here that leads outside, but along the way, there is a shoe store, a video game store and a sporting goods store. Every time I go back outside there is a feeling dread. You can tell something is off. You can never find your car. You can park it in the empty side, but it won't be there when you go back. But you'll find it on the packed side. But if you parked your car in the side that's full, you'll never ever find it when you come out of the mall. Often times there is a carnival set up on an empty piece of land nearby. There is also some kind of industrial plant across the street. Anyone run into a place like this? Maybe something similar?
